groups.problem: isTeamAdminOrOwner uses && instead of ||, so the user must be both a team admin and an owner.
groups.rationale: Both point at lines 46-48 and propose changing && to ||.

groups.problem: sendAddGuestsEmails receives the raw guests array instead of the filtered uniqueGuests.
groups.rationale: All three point at the same call and propose passing uniqueGuests instead.

groups.problem: The server schema and handler don't remove duplicate emails within one request, so duplicate attendee rows get inserted.
groups.rationale: Both report that the server lacks the client's uniqueness refine, so duplicates within one request reach createMany.

groups.problem: The handler's guest filter compares emails case-sensitively, so the duplicate-attendee check and the blacklist check can be bypassed.
groups.rationale: Both report non-normalized email comparison in the same uniqueGuests filter; lowercasing the guests fixes both.

problems: The duplicate and blacklist filtering compares emails case-sensitively.
Identical emails within the same input array are not removed.
The non-atomic read-then-write allows a race that inserts duplicate attendees.
Duplicate emails within one request are not removed.
uncoveredProblems: The non-atomic check-then-create lets concurrent addGuests requests insert duplicate attendees.
